title: Weed Risk Assessments using Climate Suitability Analysis
text: protoclim R package determining climatic suitability plant species intended support risk assessors performing formal pest risk analysis. protoclim heavily inspired influenced Proto3 technique developed used United States Department Agriculture Guidelines USDA-APHIS PPQ Weed Risk Assessment Process. protoclim designed interoperable categorical climate variable inspired Proto3 model intended used : Köppen-Geiger classes Precipitation bands Plant hardiness zones Users able bring data high-resolution global data already currated climate variables associated repository protoclimData available download Zenodo. climate variables available across present-day future time periods well various emission scenarios. addition climate data, using protoclim requires species occurrence data GBIF, Global Biodiversity Information Facility. GBIF occurrence data can downloaded GBIF website, rgbif R package, various means. protoclim comes two datasets: bryonia_alba, GBIF occurrence data Bryonia alba, white bryony climate_layers_ssp370_2011_2040, lower-resolution version associated .tif file hosted Zenodo.
